_comment: Vercel's Hobby plan runs crons once a day. The job is safe to call HOURLY (it records what it has already sent, so nothing repeats) — which is what lets the morning briefing land at ~8am in the traveller's own timezone. On Hobby, point a free external scheduler at /api/expiry-alerts?key=YOUR_CRON_SECRET every hour; on Pro, change the schedule below to '0 * * * *'.
